verdict.rationale: Retell documents a built-in analytics dashboard with success rate, latency, cost, concurrency charts/filters/breakdowns, plus AI QA scoring for sentiment, hallucination, and quality trends — directly matching the founder's need for out-of-the-box call analytics. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the dashboard's usability and no explicit evidence of an 'outcomes' taxonomy beyond success/sentiment/QA metrics.
